summary: Correct same-ID admission lock resource lifetime on cancelled wait/acquire and normal/error exits, and remove redundant post-validation same-ID conflict branch while preserving offloop writer progress, validation-before-buffer, and immutable winning payload semantics.

defect_context.symptom: In commit c584 (PR6560), lock acquire and entry refcount increment occurred outside the try/finally block in ingest_svc.py (lines 1264-1266). When a concurrent waiter was cancelled during lock.acquire(), its refcount was never decremented and entry never pruned, leaving leaked unlocked refcounts in _event_locks. Furthermore, a redundant post-validation same-ID recheck was retained despite whole same-ID ingestion already being serialized by the lock.
defect_context.resolution: Moved lock acquire inside try/finally block with an acquired flag, ensuring cancelled waiters decrement their refcount and prune unused lock entries without attempting to release an unacquired lock. Removed the duplicate post-validation same-ID branch, maintaining a single canonical validation and admission path with immutable winning payload semantics.

acceptance_verification.ac1_demonstrated_synchronization_defect: passed: Addressed the demonstrated local synchronization defect where cancelled same-ID waiter coroutines leaked refcounts and retained unused entries in _event_locks. Grounded in reproduction snapshot /tmp/pantheon-assist-20261013/telemetry-c584-lock-waiter-cancel-9e720d9d-immutable-snapshot.json (SHA 9e720d9dd8b3abf5a202827481446d07da21c66e7cdb7c54880225d2f6903310) showing A owning lock at ref1, B waiting at ref2, B cancellation leaving refcount 2 without finally decrement, and post-A completion leaving refcount 1 unlocked. Preserved delivered PR6560 (head c584 merged 29325b7) as immutable history; bounded defect fix without asserting causality for historical Root385020 latency.
acceptance_verification.ac2_lifetime_cleanup_and_redundancy_remo: passed: Corrected local synchronization resource lifetime by placing lock acquire inside try/finally and releasing only when acquired is True while decrementing refcount and popping empty entries on normal, error, or cancelled exits. Removed the duplicate post-validation same-ID content/lineage recheck added in c584, preserving single-path validation, offloop authoritative lookup, guard-before-buffer, immutable winning payload, tenant/paper-live/temporal checks, and canonical writer fence/commit-before-ACK without new frameworks, caches, queues, or services.
acceptance_verification.ac3_bounded_synchronization_and_suite_ve: passed: Enhanced test_authoritative_binding_lookup_offloads_from_asyncio_writer_loop in test_paper_runtime_ingest_contract.py to verify cancelled same-ID waiter cleanup without unacquired release, zero lock leakage (_event_locks fully cleaned up after completion and stop), and proper subsequent duplicate and conflicting-duplicate handling. All 4 telemetry test suites passed: paper-runtime (9 passed), runtime-summary (40 passed), durable-ingest (6 passed, 1 real-NATS opt-in skip), and ingest-shock-absorption (65 passed).
